objective: Preregister 7 long-only published-rule replications from the batch-2 registry triage assignment (HFEA, turn-of-month, end-of-month reversal, front-running sector seasonality, pre-FOMC drift x2, and a covered-call CEF proxy), each judged against the owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed keep rule (K1 median-offset Sharpe vs S3, K2 inverse-vol blend edge vs a vol-matched control), no backtest run yet.

s3_incumbent.description: The live month-end S3 (offset 0) via scripts/run_h20260928_01_s3_rebalance_tranching.py's offset_effective/simulate_effective, date-neutral median-offset Sharpe 1.49 anchor / 0.81 stress (owner's frozen reference figures, 2026-09-28).

vol_matched_k_s3_plus_shy_control_k2.description: k*S3 + (1-k)*SHY, k solved per window (scripts/screen_lane.py's diversifier_edge_for_offset / combo.solve_k) so std(control) matches the S3+candidate 63-day inverse-vol blend's realized volatility in that window.

per_candidate: K1: median-offset Sharpe >= 0.80 * S3's median-offset Sharpe in both anchor (S3=1.49) and stress (S3=0.81) windows, with positive CAGR at 20bp in both windows
K2: S3+candidate 63-day inverse-vol blend beats its vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >= 0.05 Sharpe in both anchor and stress windows
adoption_rule.pass_requires: K1 or K2 (owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed keep rule -- either condition is sufficient)
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 7 candidates; report all regardless of outcome
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: each non-passing candidate returns to the registry as refuted-in-this-form; no live pilot on this evidence
